The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e0e2e5e34169e701), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For every fixed p ≥ 2, throughout the path, including masses below the working interval, ∥Xu∥p ≲p √ u + x, ∥Rsplit at u∥p ≲p u + x. (12) The bounds also hold at intermediate clock revelations, with their specified mass. The norm of a random vector is its Euclidean norm inside the Lp norm.
